svg.title: V-03. Technical safety architecture, phone layout (SysML v2 view systemInterconnection)
svg.desc: V-03 laid out at phone width, generated from the same SysML v2 model and the same element texts. Top to bottom: the road environment and the driver; the cameras (IF-05, IF-06); the QM partition of the comma device with the device hardware E-04b, the SoC processes of E-01 and the ML models E-02; the SPI link and boot lines to the MCU (IF-04, IF-04b); the ASIL C envelope with the safety layer E-03a and the platform firmware E-03b and their software units, and the STM32H7 E-04a; the relay (IF-10) and the harness E-05; the car side (IF-01 to IF-03) with the EPS, ECM/PCM, ABS/VSC, cluster, forward camera and radar; then the alerts to the driver (IF-07), the supply (IF-08) and the untrusted back end (IF-09). Each block lists the safety mechanisms it performs.
svg.text: The same architecture stacked for a phone: from the road and the driver, through the QM partition
and the ASIL C envelope of the comma device, to the harness and the car

Display, speaker and siren to the driver
Network to the comma.ai back end (untrusted)

interface attaches; this layout lists them between the blocks they join.
